chunks: Blame will lie on those who are rich yet ask your leave to stay behind. They prefer to stay with women who stay at home, and God seals their hearts; so they do not understand.

key_terms.الْخَوَالِفِ: Those left behind (specifically the lazy or women)

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'Khawalif' mentioned in Surah At-Tawbah and why did God seal their hearts?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific incident of the wealthy hypocrites who delayed joining the Expedition of Tabuk, illustrating how material comfort can lead to spiritual stagnation. The phrase 'God has sealed their hearts' is interpreted not merely as divine punishment but as a natural consequence of their persistent choice to remain with the 'khawalif' (those left behind), thereby blinding them to the reality of faith. This highlights the practical implication that wealth, when coupled with complacency, can become a barrier to spiritual awareness.
